introHtml: Foam lunch bags, boxes, and totes keep food and drinks cold for hours without the weight of hard coolers. They are ideal for corporate picnics, construction site lunches, or outdoor team events where portability and insulation matter. Options like the FOAM 30-Can EVA Cooler offer generous capacity for group outings, while the Igloo Playmate Pal 7 Qt works well for individual use. Decorate with screen printing or pad printing for durable brand visibility.
